findings.title: ifleet_elevation_plan.md is a phantom reference — actual file is plan.md
findings.detail: docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md ADR-005 (lines 248, 250) cites `ifleet_elevation_plan.md` for both the channel name decision and the budget gate spec. This file does not exist anywhere in the repo or filesystem. The actual plan is `plan.md` at the repo root. Workers following the citation for context will find no file.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace both occurrences of `ifleet_elevation_plan.md` with `plan.md` in ifleet-integration-adrs.md.

findings.title: Two blocking Sebastian decisions in ADR-005 have no tracking mechanism
findings.detail: ifleet-integration-adrs.md §ADR-005 summary table (line 254) lists 5 decisions Sebastian must make before any fold-in PR. Decisions 1 (symlink vs copy) and 5 (channel name #ifleet-proposals vs #ifleet) are flagged 'Sebastian decision needed' with no default and no tracking issue. Without these resolved, the Phase 6 fold-in is technically blocked but the blockage is invisible in any task tracker.
findings.fix_sketch: Add default recommendations to the two unresolved rows in the decisions table so the fold-in can proceed with explicit defaults that Sebastian can override. Decision 1 default: copy (Windows safety); Decision 5 default: reuse #ifleet (no new channel needed).

findings.title: README.md finding count (52 open as of 2026-05-21) is stale after 14 fixes today
findings.detail: README.md line 45 states '52 open findings as of 2026-05-21'. Today's nightly audit closed 7 findings in IFleet and 7 in factory, reducing the total. The 'as of' qualifier makes it historically accurate but the number reads as current state.
findings.fix_sketch: Update README.md count to reflect post-nightly-audit state with date qualifier.
